classes.description: private data eligible for approved external AI only with explicit policy and consent

neverStore.rule: Data marked never-store must not be written to prohibited durable stores, logs, audit payloads, event payloads, backup payloads or model-provider persistence paths.

rules: Classification is assigned by trusted policy/data handling logic and cannot be silently downgraded by model or tool input.
D5 is local-only and is never eligible for external model disclosure.
Foundation v1 external model disclosure permits only D0-D2 when privacy is ai-allow, externalAI consent is true, and provider plus region are approved.
Audit, logs and events carry protected metadata or redacted/encrypted representations rather than prohibited plaintext.
Retention, deletion and backup obligations follow the governing data policy and remain effective across recovery.
